title: Sleep and weight, easier to see 🌙

items.text: Last night's sleep chart now sits on the Week tab, above Recovery. Tap any day to see that night.
No chart yet? The app now tells you what's missing: Health Connect here, and sleep sharing in Garmin Connect.
The weight chart in Trends shows every weigh-in instead of weekly averages, so daily entries draw a line right away.
Line charts, in the app and in widgets, now draw smooth curves.
When sauna is on for a workout, the Garmin workout gets a sauna timer after the last exercise, counting your minutes.
A new name and a new icon: a honeycomb in honey and the app's colors. Look for Hive on your home screen.
Health stays the first cell of the hive. More apps, like Habits, will fill the rest.
A new sleep chart on each day: awake, REM, light and deep sleep across the night.
A sleep score with efficiency, time to fall asleep, time awake, regularity and sleep debt.
Trends shows your last 14 nights by stage. Needs Health Connect turned on in Settings.
Stride is now Health, the first app inside Tend. More apps, like Habits, will join it here.
Opening the app shows your new home screen with today's plan. Widgets, notifications and shortcuts still go straight into Health.
After every update you'll see what's new right here, so you never miss a feature.
